apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: cassandra-stress-normal
  labels:
    app: cassandra-stress
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: cassandra-stress-profile-volume
    configMap:
      name: cassandra-stress-normal
  securityContext:
    fsGroup: 1
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1006
    supplementalGroups:
    - 1
  containers:
  - name: cassie1-cassandra-stress
    image: cassandra:stable
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    securityContext:
      capabilities:
        add:
        - IPC_LOCK
        drop:
        - ALL
        - NET_RAW
        - NET_ADMIN
        - SYS_ADMIN
        - SYS_MODULE
        - SYS_PTRACE
        - SYS_CHROOT
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      privileged: false
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      runAsNonRoot: true
    command:
    - /bin/sh
    args:
    - -c
    - cassandra-stress 'user profile=/opt/cassandra-stress/normal_stress.yaml ops(insert=10,query_by_sub_id=8)
      duration=120m cl=one -node cassandra-demo -mode native cql3 user=bench password=monbench
      -rate threads=30 -pop seq=0..100M -tokenrange -graph file=/tmp/stress-normal.html'
      && echo END && while true ; do sleep 60; done
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: '3'
        memory: 8Gi
      requests:
        cpu: '3'
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
    - name: cassandra-stress-profile-volume
      mountPath: /opt/cassandra-stress

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tickets-celery
  labels:
    app: tickets-celery
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: tickets-celery
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: tickets-celery
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: tickets-celery
        image: ckreuzberger/tickets:1.0
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        command:
        - celery
        args:
        - -A
        - tickets
        - worker
        - --loglevel=info
        env:
        - name: POSTGRES_USER
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: postgres-credentials
              key: user
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: postgres-credentials
              key: password
        - name: POSTGRES_DB
          value: tickets
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          value: postgres://$(POSTGRES_USER):$(POSTGRES_PASSWORD)@postgres:5432/$(POSTGRES_DB)
        - name: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
          value: tickets.settings.prod
        - name: SECRET_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: django-secret-key
              key: secret_key
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
